sources.title: Public Procurement Use and Promotion of Domestic Products Directive, 2083
sources.publisher: Office of Prime Minister and Council of Ministers, Nepal
sources.locator: PDF p.2 sections 4, 5(3), 5(4), 6(1); p.3 sections 7 and 8
supported_facts: Section 5(3) makes road alternatives with domestic cement/local materials conditional on technical appropriateness.
Section 5(4) requires the study/design report to justify foreign material/technology and explain why the domestic alternative is unsuitable.
Sections 7-8 require documenting availability, quality, technical suitability, quantity/timing, and reasons for permitted foreign procurement.
sources.limitations: Scanned Nepali document was visually read on pages 2-3 because embedded OCR is corrupt. Analysis is an English paraphrase, not an official translation or comprehensive legal opinion.

sources.title: Government to prioritize construction of cement roads in place of blacktopped roads
supported_facts: Article matching the screenshot reports Cabinet approval of the domestic-products directive.
Article text retains the condition that domestic road alternatives be technically appropriate.
sources.limitations: News reporting is contextual evidence; official directive NP01 is authoritative for the wording. It does not establish industry influence or validate a universal material choice.

sources.title: Guidelines for the Design of Flexible Pavements (Second Edition 2021)
supported_facts: The design framework considers wheel loads, traffic, climate, terrain, subgrade and available materials.
Main framework covers traffic above 2 million standard axles; annexes include low-volume roads and surface dressing.
Includes cement-treated base/subbase, crack-relief layers and SAMI, showing cement can be used beneath an asphalt surface.
sources.limitations: Design guidance is not a nationwide policy life-cycle cost comparison. Verify applicable amendments and project contract specifications before design.

sources.title: Pavement Design Guidelines (Rigid Pavement), 2021
supported_facts: Covers jointed plain concrete pavement; scope is daily commercial traffic above450 vehicles with laden weight above3tonnes, excluding low-volume rural roads.
Design includes traffic-load fatigue, temperature stress, subgrade/base, joints, dowels/tie bars and drainage.
Common transverse-joint spacing cited is4.5m; design-period guidance generally30years, with20years sometimes considered.
Recommends continuous48-hour axle survey with sample thresholds depending on commercial traffic volume.
sources.limitations: Design period is an assumption/target, not guaranteed field service life. Do not apply the guideline directly to low-volume rural roads.

sources.title: Guideline for Construction of Cement Treated Sub-base/Base (2024)
supported_facts: CTB is an established Nepal option with material, mix design and construction guidance.
Seven-day unconfined compressive strength targets: CTB4.5–7MPa; CTSB1.5–3MPa.
Cement content is determined by strength and durability criteria, not a universally fixed percentage.
Guideline includes a crack-relief layer requirement/design section.
sources.limitations: Specifying an illustrative cement percentage or layer thickness is not a structural design. Site material trials, durability tests and construction acceptance are necessary.

sources.title: Foreign Direct Investment in Cement Industry in Nepal: A Study on Socio-economic Impact
sources.publisher: Nepal Rastra Bank, Economic Research Department
supported_facts: 2018/19 installed cement capacity15million tonnes/year across55industries; domestic output7.49million tonnes; domestic demand9.05million tonnes.
Seven sampled factories averaged50.41% capacity utilization.
Report identifies certification, consistency and bulk supply constraints plus local pollution effects.
sources.limitations: Historical snapshot, not2026capacity. Seven-factory operational sample and judgmental community sampling limit generalizability. Do not present future demand projections as facts.

sources.title: Nepal Country Climate and Development Report
supported_facts: Roads are exposed to heavy rainfall, floods and landslides.
Report estimates strategic-road-network direct climate-damage repair costs at NPR3–6billion/year over its next10years.
Indirect costs estimated50–75%of direct costs, conditional on prompt repair.
sources.limitations: Model-based2022projection, not an observed current annual bill; cannot attribute all climate damage to asphalt or claim concrete prevents slope/bridge failure.

sources.title: Thickness and Cost Comparison of Cement Treated and Granular Base for Flexible Pavement: A Case Study of Pathlaiya-Nijgadh Section of East-West Highway of Nepal
sources.publisher: Journal of Engineering Technology and Planning;Narayan KC,Rajendra Aryal,Buddhi Raj Joshi,Padma Bahadur Shahi
supported_facts: Models15-year design traffic34.86msa at5%annual growth and8%effectiveCBR.
Reports CTB pavement initial estimate5.63%lower and combined initial+maintenance estimate24.39%lower than granular-base pavement for its assumptions.
sources.limitations: One corridor analytical estimate, not randomized field evidence or universal saving; not rigid-versus-flexible national comparison. Do not import its rupee estimates into2026without updating rates.

sources.title: Comparative study of flexible and rigid pavement
sources.publisher: Nepal Research and Innovation Center;Alpha Sharma,Dharma Maharjan,Junu Shrestha,Dipika Rai
supported_facts: Public review explicitly says location, traffic and subgrade affect pavement life-cycle cost and region-specific studies are needed.
sources.limitations: Review/abstract page, not a government-commissioned2026policy appraisal or completed nationwide comparison.

sources.title: Life Cycle Cost Analysis of Flexible and Rigid Pavemtn MatrerIal
supported_facts: Abstract describes a24kmButwal case comparison using a30-year analysis and reports28%higher rigid construction cost.
sources.limitations: Abstract reviewed only; low evidentiary weight until full methods/rates and consistency independently audited. Shows comparative literature exists, not that the policy is justified.

sources.title: Pavement Analysis System: User Manual
supported_facts: Official tool calculates layered elastic stresses,strains and displacements and provides performance checks.
Manual identifies presumptive material values as preliminary and requires site-specific lab results for final design.
sources.limitations: Analytical elastic pavement tool, not a model of landslides,hydraulic failure or observed pavement life; no project calculation performed here.
